onset.Description: Onset of the event in seconds from the start of the scan

duration.Description: Duration of the event in seconds

trial_type.Description: Type of trial presented during the task

food_name.Description: Name of the food presented at this event.

frequency.Description: Participant-reported frequency of consuming the food item, demeaned within subject and run. n/a for auction and missed trials.

healthy.Description: Participant-rated healthiness of the food item, demeaned within subject and run. n/a for auction and missed trials.

wtp.Description: Bid amount normalized to $0-$5 scale then demeaned within subject and run. n/a for auction and missed trials.
